questions.prompt: Which approach best demonstrates understanding of “Introduction to Ruby”?
options: Assume Ruby automatically guarantees every business rule and external system behavior.
Replace all built-in features with a third-party framework regardless of the task.
Skip tests because a short example ran once.
Use Introduction to Ruby deliberately: state the expected behavior, apply it in a small example, and verify a boundary case.
questions.answer_key: Use Introduction to Ruby deliberately: state the expected behavior, apply it in a small example, and verify a boundary case.
questions.explanation: Use Introduction to Ruby deliberately: state the expected behavior, apply it in a small example, and verify a boundary case. The alternatives overstate Ruby guarantees or encourage unverified behavior.
